work_done: Cleaned up glass shards and removed glass still in bedroom window frame. Taped any sharp edges on the roller door and removed any loose glass. Framed both bedroom window and sliding door, then screwed plyboard onto the frame creating a secure and safe environment from intruders. And disposed of glass and off cuts.

Damage: Completely smashed bedroom window and smashed roller door around handle. Glass shattered around window area.
